Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Updates (coverage_matrix.csv XLSX Tab 'Updates', 2.49 grab-bag section) > 'Prompted Update Scenario 2' - 'Forced CommCare update blocker'. This is the Updates(2.49)-tab's OWN Prompted Update Scenario 2, distinct from the Prompted Updates tab's 'Prompted Update Scenario 2' ('Forced CCZ update blocker screen' - an app-content/CCZ update, see hq_setup/prompted_updates/ for that one, handled separately). This row is about the CommCare BINARY (APK) forced-update blocker screen, so it toggles apk_prompt (not app_prompt) to 'forced' via HQ's update_prompts/<app_id>/ endpoint (PromptSettingsUpdateView).

UPDATE (2026-08-25), ROOT CAUSE FOUND for the whole 'forced never shows any prompt' mystery, per direct user instruction: apk_version was left OUT of this action's own JSON, on the wrong assumption that PromptSettingsUpdateView is a partial PATCH that would just inherit whatever Setup 2 last set. It isn't - hq_client.py's set_prompt_update_settings() POSTs the WHOLE PromptUpdateSettingsForm every call, and any field this action doesn't supply falls back to the Python method's own default (apk_version=LATEST_APK_VALUE, i.e. plain 'latest'). So every real dispatch of this file was SILENTLY RESETTING apk_version from Setup 2's correct dev-build target back down to 'latest' (whatever's currently released) the moment apk_prompt flipped to forced - and since the device is already on-or-past whatever's currently released, a forced prompt targeting 'latest' has nothing newer to ever prompt toward. This is why the optional case (scenario_01, which never runs this file) always worked while forced never showed anything at all, across every real dispatch this session. Fixed by explicitly setting apk_version to the same DEV_APK_VALUE sentinel Setup 2 uses, so the dev-build target survives this second POST instead of reverting.

UPDATE (2026-08-24, 2nd correction), per a direct user-supplied screen recording of this exact test's real, working HQ configuration: app_prompt is 'on' there, not 'off' - corrected to match (the original 'off' was a defensive guess to avoid an app-level CCZ prompt confounding the on-device flow's assertions, but the real demonstrated setup runs with both prompts on simultaneously and still works, presumably because the forced CommCare-level blocker never lets the device reach a point where an app-level prompt would show anyway).

UPDATE (2026-08-24), per direct user-supplied app link (https://www.commcarehq.org/a/qateam/apps/view/8a04cdf1b9474ee2b090b1d7896b1bd7/) + screen recording: app_id switched to '[Master] Basic Tests NS Copy' (app_registry.py's BASIC_TESTS_NS_COPY entry), matching Setup 2's own switch.

UPDATE (3rd correction, same day): the real '2.63.1 ceiling' blocker Setup 2 needed past is now genuinely resolved - see hq_setup/updates_2_49/setup_02_commcare_version_plus_one.json's own header for the full citation (alpha/dev CommCare versions like '2.65.0/latest' are real, valid, HQ-known choices, just hidden from a regular user's own Manage Update Settings dropdown - confirmed live via a superuser session cookie; the regular automation account can still WRITE the value once its CSRF cookie is primed, no superuser needed for actual test runs). An earlier version of this UPDATE claimed '2.65.0/dev' was the fix - that was disproven live and is not the real value; Setup 2 now sets '2.65.0/latest' instead.

UPDATE (2026-08-24, per direct user instruction): Setup 2's own hardcoded '2.65.0/latest' has since been replaced with hq_client.py's dynamic DEV_APK_VALUE sentinel (see that file's own latest UPDATE), and now (per the ROOT CAUSE fix above) this file resolves the SAME sentinel itself rather than relying on inheritance. Combined with prompted_update_scenario_01_ill_update_later.yaml as one logical 'Scenario 1 -> Scenario 2' progression (both/apk prompts on -> apk prompt forced, same target build throughout) - run Setup 2, then scenario_01's flow (asserts BOTH the optional prompt's Play-Store option and 'I'll update later' appear), then this file, then scenario_02's flow (asserts the forced blocker appears and 'I'll update later' is now gone), then hq_setup/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_teardown.json.

Run via `python scripts/hq_client.py hq_setup/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_02_forced.json` before flows/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_02_forced_commcare_update.yaml.
